facts.fact: Consumer KV connector and max_concurrent_batches>1 enables defer_block_free because KV loads may not be ordered with GPU writes.
update_from_output assumes all GPU writes complete, increments processed_step_seq on nonempty step, then drains deferred_frees.
A request can free KV only when last_sched_seq<=processed_step_seq; CoW retention uses future fence and deferred_frees.
has_requests covers live/finished requests and connector push work, but does not explicitly keep polling only for remaining GPU retirements.
Original native copy event is recorded after native copy stream waits on the current model stream; get_output synchronizes this event.
Existing KVOutputAggregator tracks expected worker completions; any separate retirement acknowledgement must require all16, not the first rank.

decision: Do not publish early merely by substituting copy-ready event. Current shadow keeps original late native completion. A future prototype must independently retire GPU/KV, preserve all16 completion and source ownership, handle abort before output and zero-token/CoW-only drain, and run fresh immutable build with correctness/cancel/reuse gates.
implementation_status: Retirement split not implemented. Current device shadow and its profile must pass before any dependent publication prototype.
scope: Exact pinned source audit and design constraints; not a runtime proof or performance result.
